### `entasis_cook_big_compound`

builds a portable tree-accelerated compound from caller-provided child bounds

child bounds are supplied by the asset pipeline

```c
ENTASIS_COOKING_API entasis_status_t ENTASIS_COOKING_CALL entasis_cook_big_compound(entasis_cooking_context_t * context, const entasis_cooked_big_compound_child_t * children, uint64_t count, entasis_cooked_big_compound_t * out_cooked, entasis_diagnostic_t * diagnostic);
```

| Parameter    | C type                                        | Meaning                                                                      |
| ------------ | --------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `context`    | `entasis_cooking_context_t *`                 | target cooking context                                                       |
| `children`   | `const entasis_cooked_big_compound_child_t *` | input cooked big compound child array                                        |
| `count`      | `uint64_t`                                    | number of entries in the input arrays                                        |
| `out_cooked` | `entasis_cooked_big_compound_t *`             | receives the cooked big compound                                             |
| `diagnostic` | `entasis_diagnostic_t *`                      | optional diagnostic output, or NULL when detailed failure data is not needed |

returns ENTASIS_STATUS_OK on success or a failure status

### `entasis_cook_hull`

builds immutable convex hull data from a caller-provided point cloud

safe on a background worker when the context and input are owned by that worker

```c
ENTASIS_COOKING_API entasis_status_t ENTASIS_COOKING_CALL entasis_cook_hull(entasis_cooking_context_t * context, const entasis_vector3_t * points, uint64_t count, entasis_cooked_hull_t * out_cooked, entasis_vector3_t * out_center, entasis_diagnostic_t * diagnostic);
```

| Parameter    | C type                        | Meaning                                                                      |
| ------------ | ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `context`    | `entasis_cooking_context_t *` | target cooking context                                                       |
| `points`     | `const entasis_vector3_t *`   | input point cloud                                                            |
| `count`      | `uint64_t`                    | number of entries in the input arrays                                        |
| `out_cooked` | `entasis_cooked_hull_t *`     | receives the cooked hull                                                     |
| `out_center` | `entasis_vector3_t *`         | receives the computed center of mass                                         |
| `diagnostic` | `entasis_diagnostic_t *`      | optional diagnostic output, or NULL when detailed failure data is not needed |

returns ENTASIS_STATUS_OK on success or a failure status

### `entasis_cooked_mesh_closed_mass_properties`

computes closed-solid mass properties for a cooked mesh

when recenter is true, the cooked mesh geometry and acceleration tree are shifted so the returned center becomes the body pose offset


| ---------------- | ---------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `cooked`         | `entasis_cooked_mesh_t *`          | target cooked asset                                                          |
